A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Before we get started.

Answers to common questions about our fittings and manufacturing capabilities.

Can you manufacture to our dimensions?

Yes. We can discuss custom dimensions and tooling around your requirements. Include the fitting, dimensions and expected quantity in your enquiry so our team can review the specification.

Which aluminium material grades are available?

Our scaffolding catalogue lists ADC-12, LM-6 and LM-25 for many fittings. The company presentation also lists LM-25 T6. Availability and suitability are confirmed for your selected model and application.

Do you supply international orders?

Yes. We serve customers in more than 10 countries. Tell us your destination country and order requirements so we can discuss the relevant dispatch arrangements.

How do I get a price for my order?

Select a product or choose Custom product in the quote form. Pricing depends on the model, dimensions, material grade, quantity and any additional finishing or tooling requirements.

What quality checks do you carry out?

Weight checks help assess consistency against the specified component weight. Destructive testing assesses durability and failure behaviour. Ask us about the inspection requirements and documentation for your order.

What is your minimum order quantity and lead time?

Minimum quantities and lead times depend on the model, material, customisation and production requirements. Our team will confirm these when reviewing your enquiry.
